dashboard_trackers.notes: Current results concern accountability, sanctions over alleged earlier chlorine use and humanitarian conditions rather than a distinct same-day SAF-RSF offensive, new chemical deployment or Red Sea spillover. The already-extreme lane holds at 90%

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters-syndicated reporting says a Tuesday Israeli strike in Gaza City's Sabra neighbourhood killed a father, mother and four children; Israel confirmed the strike and said it was reviewing the outcome. This is fresh hostile-action evidence, but the near-ceiling lane holds at 88% without inflation

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh confirmed Abyei or Uganda-South Sudan border attack surfaced. A current humanitarian assessment concerns families displaced by the previously corroborated Kajo-Keji skirmish; risk holds at 17%

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: Current searches returned analysis and humanitarian follow-up but no distinct same-day FARDC-M23 or Rwanda-linked battlefield escalation. The lane holds at 52%

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters confirms Red Sea war-insurance costs rose after the Houthi shipping declaration, and the Saudi-led coalition says it will protect navigation. No attributable post-declaration attack, interdiction, Saudi strike or broad rerouting was verified; risk holds at 46%

dashboard_trackers.name: MALI SAHEL
dashboard_trackers.notes: Fresh publications continue to describe the already-scored Anefis-Gao convoy ambush and its heavy losses. A separate western-Niger attack had two conflict reports plus a generic UN threat item, short of the configured fresh-event gate; no new strategic seizure or regional intervention surfaced

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH CHINA SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: China and the Philippines summoned each other's envoys after the already-scored Second Thomas Shoal clash. This deepens the diplomatic row but adds no firearm use, death, vessel seizure, new force deployment or treaty consultation; raw risk holds at 21%

dashboard_trackers.name: SOMALIA GULF OF ADEN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Current maritime coverage continues to corroborate the Asana hijack and diversion toward Somali waters, not a second event. No rescue outcome, crew harm, ransom demand or new interdiction surfaced; the lane holds at 28%
